summary: Set select.value using option-value matching and selection algorithms.

target.notes: Convert to DOMString, select the first option whose value equals it, deselect other options as required by the setter; if no match exists, leave no option selected.

caveats: Do not implement as a dictionary lookup; option order and selectedness side effects matter.

tests.name: selects matching value
tests.input: const s=document.createElement('select'); s.innerHTML='<option value=a>A</option><option value=b>B</option>'; s.value='b'; console.log(s.selectedIndex);
